## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      3 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 11 mars 2026 - 9 juin 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Kitkattango12_, 17 avr. 2026, 5/5: "I’ve tried a lot of different apps + paper strategies over the years to track habits, and this app has been the best by a mile. It’s easy to set up and stick with, enjoyable to use and visually beautiful, flexible to my needs while keeping me accountable. One underrated excellent feature is that they give you fine-tuned control over the notifications you receive — probably the #1 reason I’ve deleted other habit apps was that they spammed me with a billion distracting notifications, but Not Boring doesn’t create this issue. Price is perfectly reasonable/well worth it. There’s only one minor feature I’d like them to add: I’d love if I could toggle on a “don’t skip 2” option in the settings - I.e. make it so that streaks are only considered “broken” if you miss 2 instances. But otherwise literally perfect."
<!--/ir-theme-->
